lines.text: Many learners say: I am on the work now.
Better: I am at work now.
At! She is at work today.

data.wrong: I am on the work now.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am on the work now.”? 😅 По-русски «на работе», и в английский тянется “on”. Нужно “at work”. Правильно: “I am at work now.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “at”. На работе — at work. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: For your job, say “at work”, with no “the” and no “on”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I am on the work now.”? 😅 In Russian it is “na rabote”, so “on” sneaks in. You need “at work”. Correct: “I am at work now.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
